name: trustpilot-mcp
description: Trustpilot (social): me, read_mentions, reply_comment. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_trustpilot_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_trustpilot_client_id.description: Trustpilot API key (Client ID); HTTP Basic username on the refresh request ('Authorization: Basic [BASE64_ENCODED(API_KEY:API_SECRET)]', https://developers.trustpilot.com/authentication).

platform_mcp_trustpilot_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_trustpilot_client_secret.description: Trustpilot API secret; HTTP Basic password on the refresh request.

platform_mcp_trustpilot_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_trustpilot_refresh_token.description: Business-user refresh token from the authorization-code or password grant. 'Access tokens expire after 100 hours and refresh tokens expire after 30 days'; the runtime mints access tokens from it and keeps a returned new refresh token (PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR persists it).

platform_mcp_trustpilot_business_unit_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
platform_mcp_trustpilot_business_unit_id.description: Business unit id (GET /v1/business-units/find?name=<domain> with the API key).

platform_mcp_trustpilot_business_user_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_BUSINESS_USER_ID
platform_mcp_trustpilot_business_user_id.description: Id of the business user replies are authored by (authorBusinessUserId).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No who-am-I endpoint: fetches one private review of config business_unit_id, which verifies the business-user token and the unit (account.reviews[0].businessUnit).

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.description: The business unit's REVIEWS as mentions (private endpoint, newest first; stars, title, companyReply, consumer email in raw). Limited to 100,000 records; `since` is not sent.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: Posts the company reply to review `comment_id` (id from read_mentions), authored by config business_user_id. A review has a single reply and the response body is not documented, so `id` is a fixed marker.
